method: Independent JPEG APP1 XMP namespace parsing, exact embedded byte-range SHA256, structural ISO BMFF video-track inspection, saved direct-HTTP destination originals and links; no checker imports or filename pairing inference

official_references.applies: Walks item lengths backwards from complete file length to locate the video byte range.

limits: No pixel, frame or audio decoding and no playback claim.
Current MotionPhoto format deprecates MicroVideo fields; this corpus validates explicitly named legacy compatibility backed by exact content proof.
Pair-link byte correctness and destination media-type correctness are separate conclusions.
Modern Container:Directory, HEIC/AVIF and ambiguous/malformed motion metadata need separate tests.
privacy: No GPS, camera position, account URLs, descriptions, raw XMP packets or credentials retained.
